sentences.text: 该条件以阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔和阿巴·勒纳命名。
sentences.evidence: The Marshall–Lerner condition (after Alfred Marshall and Abba P. Lerner)

sentences.text: 其含义是：贬值对贸易数量的间接效应将超过进口价格上升、出口价格下降的直接效应。
sentences.evidence: the Marshall-Lerner condition implies that the indirect effect on the quantity of trade will exceed the direct effect of the country having to pay a higher price for its imports and receive a lower price for its exports

sentences.text: 时间越短需求越缺乏弹性，时间越长消费者对价格变化反应越大。
sentences.evidence: the shorter the time frame, the less elastic is demand.  In the long run, consumers react more to changed prices: demand is more elastic the longer the time frame.
